items.name: Incidere — Incident Response
items.description: Three-worker incident response crew: triage the signal, draft stakeholder comms, execute approval-gated mitigation. Reads your repo's runbooks and incident history for context.
items.author: proagents

items.name: PR Review Gate
items.description: Two-worker pull-request review crew: a read-only security/architecture reviewer and a standards checker that drafts the review verdict for humans to approve. Strictly read-only on the repo.
items.author: proagents

items.name: Test Healer
items.description: Single agent that diagnoses failing tests, separates real regressions from brittle assertions, and proposes minimal patches for humans to review.
items.author: proagents
